propositions: The code-review tests overlay is currently selected only when a changed file matches test globs, missing cases where product logic is added without test file changes.
Four real merges (Gerrit 388, 1920, 1737, 1703) added declarations without test files and later produced bugs, demonstrating the gap in overlay coverage.

A new content-triggered detector must fire when an added line matches the polyglot declaration regex (_REMOVED_DECL_RE) and no changed file matches the tests globs, while suppressing pure rewrites and anonymous declarations.
The detector receives both raw diff text and composed context (truncated at 60000 chars) and must pass the changed_files list as a keyword-only argument to content_triggered_overlays.

Guard (vii) in code-review-tests.md must narrow coverage-gap findings to only block when newly-introduced behaviour (lines appearing as added in the diff) is present and a named violating input is specified.
The implementation is portable across languages (Go func, Rust fn, Python def/class, JS/TS function/arrow/class) and repository layouts, with no src/ or language-specific predicates.
